notes.title: 2 games are in development!
notes.content:
[h2]Introduction[/h2]
Hello everybody! Today I am going to announce two games, I've been developing. There is one big story-focused game and one simple gameplay-focused platformer.

[h2]About the big story-focused game[/h2]
I haven't named this project yet. It is a game, which contains both simulator and visual novel types in one project. The story will start as a post-apocalyptic slice of life and will proceed as a more plot-focused. The simulator part will have a simple mechanics: do things = change stats. The stats will make a small impact on a story progression and a large impact on some events. For now, I can not tell more details, because there still a lot have to be done. The development of this game certainly will take over a year. I'll make a steam page asap.

[h2]About the simple game[/h2]
"Easy Simple Game" is a gameplay-focused platformer. Fast actions and high accuracy are welcome. Although it is all about gameplay, there still will be a little fun story. The game will be cheap and fun. I'd appreciate if you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2100230/Easy_Simple_Game/]add it to your wishlist[/url]. The main reason for making this game is that I need a lot of time to make a VN, which is mentioned before. The better this "Easy Simple Game" will be sold - the more time I'll be able to work on the big game.

[h2]Plans[/h2]
I plan on making some simple games (not only platformers), while I work on the big one. If everything will be ok, I'll be able to focus on the VN. So, everything depends on how many people will like these small games and the VN I'm working on.
About my first game (Lost Wish: In the desperate world) - I will make small updates from time to time and fix bugs if there still will be any. I also want to make a detailed walkthrough to unlock every possible achievement is a single run.
The other thing I want to do - is to make a simple site about my works, but I'll do it later.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 - some fixes
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
Jump power is increased a bit. It is now easier to reach some surfaces.
Some help signs changes.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
Stardust ability now can't hurt some objects (mostly on bossfights).
Some enemy spawners had a chance to be completely turned off.
Fixed some performance issues.

[b]"It is a feature, not a  bug"[/b]
You can use an item that is not selected by abusing the pause system. I am not planning on removing this feature. This feature is used in the speedrun, so I decided to let it be.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - balance
notes.content:
[h1]Balance:[/h1]

	[b]difficulties changed[/b]
	•"easy" mode is now "normal" mode
	•"normal" mode is now "hard" mode

	[b]all difficulties:[/b]
	•first boss deals less damage on the 2nd phase
	
	[b]easy (now normal) mode:[/b]
	•turned on by default (if you launch the game for the first time)
	•almost all mobs became easier
	•mimics deal less damage
	•almost all bosses became a bit easier
	Old easy mode effects are untouched (slightly more damage, more hp from the start, more hp from hearts and healling effects, passive hp regen)
	
	[b]normal (now hard) mode:[/b]
	•3d "??? " boss have slightly more HP

[h1]Game design:[/h1]
	
	•menu now have some additional effects
	•the tip on how to beat the 2nd  "???" boss is now showed before the battle (instead of when dying)
	•living statues in the City of Lost now have an additional visual effect
	•there is now a confirmation sign when you try to delete the save
	
[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
	
	•screenshots fixed
	•some small bugs fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 and some plans
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
Changes 1.0.2 and 1.0.3:
• portals are now marked on the map
• screenshot feauture should work now

[b]Plans:[/b]
A small rebalance of the easy mode is coming soon (gameplay would be easier). If you send a bug report, it will be fixed soon. The new project is in development, but it is still on the concept stage. Some details will be shared after a few months.

If you find any bugs, write about them on steam or send a report to: innocentsouldev@mail.ru.

Best regards, Innocent Soul.
